geology_notes: Churchill Resources holds the Foxtrot past-producing antimony mine (Frost Cove / Black Raven property) in central Newfoundland, augmented by the March 2026 Golden Baie option (39,925 ha, TSXV-approved March 27, 2026) and a Black Raven LOI. Confirmed geological highlights from prior disclosures: (1) FC25-27: 13.00% Sb over 0.57m at Frost Cove (validated in the May 2026 data-correction release); (2) a second new polymetallic system at southern Frost Cove / Black Raven yielding 7.25% Sb over 1.98m; (3) exceptional intercepts of 35.1% and 29.7% Sb at the Black Raven past-producers; (4) a 20-vein Au-Ag-Mo-Pb-Zn swarm at Pomley Cove Pond with surface channel results including 17.3 g/t Au and 130 g/t Ag; (5) zinc grab samples at Black Raven reaching 5.25%, 11.03%, and 12.11% Zn with associated Au, Ag, and Pb; (6) high-grade antimony (9.46% Sb) with gold (35.5 g/t) and silver (1,118 g/t) discovered 1.2km north of the historic Frost Cove mine; (7) new Taylors Room polymetallic system: 10.59 g/t AuEq over 1.05m and 4.12 g/t AuEq over 1.80m. The two-rig 2026 drill program launched March 23; nine holes were reported completed circa July 13 with assay results still pending. August 2023 NI 43-101 technical report remains most recent on file; all resource/reserve fields are null per the extracted filings. No new geological disclosures confirmed as of August 27, 2026. Score of 3: confirmed high-grade multi-commodity mineralisation across a consolidated and expanding NL property package, constrained by the absence of a compliant resource estimate and forty-five days of post-drill assay silence.

Confirmed geological highlights include: 13.00% Sb over 0.57m at Frost Cove (validated May 2026), 35.1% and 29.7% Sb at the Black Raven past-producers, 7.25% Sb over 1.98m at a second polymetallic system, 9.46% Sb with 35.5 g/t Au and 1,118 g/t Ag discovered 1.2km north of the historic mine, 17.3 g/t Au and 130 g/t Ag at Pomley Cove Pond veins, up to 12.11% Zn grab samples at Black Raven, and a new Taylors Room polymetallic system yielding 10.59 g/t AuEq over 1.05m. The two-rig 2026 drill program launched March 23; nine holes completed circa July 13. Cap table per the April 2026 MD&A extraction: 316,681,940 shares issued and outstanding; 342,756,940 fully diluted (2,625,000 warrants + 23,450,000 options — strike prices and expiry dates not extracted). No NI 43-101 compliant resource estimate on file; all resource/reserve fields are null. No flow-through tranches detected in the April 2026 MD&A. Maintain WATCH at low confidence: the intact macro antimony tailwind and confirmed high-grade multi-commodity surface results at an expanding NL property package are genuine positives, but forty-five days of assay silence past 'imminent' prevents any upgrade in conviction. The 2026 assay release remains the single binary event that could meaningfully change the verdict.
